description: NaLaTiP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.86 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.41 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-42°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.55 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom.
